[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Trem DeSelvaine''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] working for the [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]]. He had an attraction to [[Nela Pentase]], who worked in the accounting department. Alongside several other researchers, DeSelvaine was tasked with studying a captured [[Polydroxol]]. DeSelvaine discovered that the creature&mdash;whom he nicknamed "[[Polly (Polydroxol)|Polly]]"&mdash; had mimetic capabilities and the fact it was an intelligent creature. Despite these revelations, DeSelvaine was ordered to terminate the creature by [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Renerdat]] using a [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] developed by Doctor [[Sera (scientist)|Sera]]. Before DeSelvaine could administer the poison, he was killed by Polydroxol.<ref name="SS" />
